method: Question: when an EDGE EXH label fires, does it reach its own target before its own stop, and does the state of the MAs and of CVD at that moment help? Method: I read each label (entry, target, stop) from your 4H screenshots, then followed the price on the chart to see which was hit first. Targets are about 3 times the stop on every label I checked. MA state = green line above or below the orange line on the label's bar. CVD state = whether the CVD pane was falling or rising in the label's direction over the last few bars. Where I could not read a state, it says Not read. These are chart readings, not exact data.

findings.title: The raw results flatter the labels
findings.body: This window holds two big trends, many labels are the same move counted more than once, and I let each label run for up to about 4 weeks. Do not read the R total as something to expect.

findings.title: Buy labels during the fall lost
findings.body: On gold and silver, the buy labels that appeared while price was dropping (23 Oct, 13 Nov, and 4 Nov on silver) were all stopped out. The 20 Nov gold buy is still open and CVD is against it.

findings.title: CVD: agreeing went with targets, against went with stops
findings.body: See the CVD bars above for the counts. Only gold and silver have been read so far, so it is a hint, not evidence. The one winner with CVD against was the early top sell on gold (5 Nov).

findings.title: The best sells came before the cross
findings.body: On gold, the EDGE EXH sells at 4,127 (5 Nov) and 4,141 (9 Nov) fired while the MAs were still bullish and CVD was not falling. Both won. The red MA cross came about 2 days later, near 4,080. A rule that waits for the cross and for CVD to agree would have entered about 50 points lower. The cost of the earlier entry is more false tops: the 28 Oct sell was stopped out by about 0.3 points.

findings.title: CVD resets every week
findings.body: On 4H the CVD pane resets on Monday, so the line jumps. A buy can look like rising CVD only because of the jump (silver, 4 Nov, which was stopped out). Read the dashboard CVD TREND row (5 bars) or exported numbers, not the picture at a reset.

findings.title: Next steps
findings.body: 1) Read the MA state and the 5-bar CVD trend at every label on all ten symbols. 2) Score only the labels where both agree at that moment, and compare with the rest. 3) Cap the holding time (for example 5 days) so slow wins do not flatter the result. 4) After the Plus export, replace my chart reading with exact numbers.
